baseline: current Pine minCenterPips3, no DMA, no stop, moving SMA20 full exit
dma_definition: DMA[i]=mean(close[i-5:i-2]), Python exclusive upper bound; Pine ta.sma(close,3)[3]. First finite index5. DMAprev=i-1, no future prices
data_inputs: recheck raw Bars.dat stats, cache/manifest hashes, truncate ALL symbols before 2026-08-31 before features used in simulation; no source mutation
data_quality_scope: known GBPJPY 2026-08-31 source price-scale anomaly and all subsequent bars excluded by common end boundary, not corrected
entry_rules: existing confirmed BB20 population3sigma preparation, expiry3, return inside bands, impulse/wick exclusions, min center3pips +1e-9pips tolerance. Then DMA gate on first eligible candidate only; if false cancel preparation and do not rearm samebar. Successful signal enters next available open including gaps

exit_rules.reward_risk_ratio: user existing dynamic centralSMA full exit, not fixed RR
exit_rules.target_update: after current-bar fill evaluation, next bar uses newly confirmed SMA20

period_semantics: inclusive start/exclusive end; independent flat segmented portfolios and separate continuous; no forced end exit in PF; cost-adjusted open mark separately reported
prior_exposure: all periods previously viewed, NOT untouched holdout
cost_and_fill_model: fixed1.4 and metadata spread/pip+0.2 pips; raw OHLC and one full cost at exit; no swaps/variable spreads/liquidity/margin; no fake monetary win relabeling
position_sizing_and_currency: one fixed-unit position per symbol; equal-pip research score NOT account-currency money
training_improvement_gates: BOTH costs, segment1: aggregate winrate strictly higher; PF and average net not lower (numerical tolerance1e-12 for ratios,1e-9pips for average); trades>=30 and >=25% baseline; at least6/9 pairs strictly higher winrate with nonzero counts
training_selection: eligible DMA candidates ranked by minimum across cost cases of aggregate winrate uplift descending, then minimum PF uplift descending, then ID ascending; one selected maximum; save selection BEFORE later simulations; no fallback
evaluation_access: All three segment1; only baseline + preselected candidate later; no selected => baseline-only later; no fallback.
later_improvement_gates: selected must meet same BOTH-cost winrate/PF/mean/sample-retention/6-pair gates in segment2, segment3_partial and continuous; count>=30 each segment, >=100 continuous, and >=25% matching baseline count everywhere
profit_requirement: separate from winrate improvement, clarified BEFORE outcomes: all evaluated segments and continuous closed net>0 AND net+open>0 in BOTH costs are necessary for future adoption consideration, not automatic live approval
report_fields: pair/period/cost trades wins winrate PF mean net closed/open/net+open, individual MTM/realized DD, baseline deltas, distance and DMA cancellations, complete improvement checks
cross_symbol_rule: same single filter across nine; no winning-symbol postselection
code_identifier: save hashes of current Pine, source, old baseline, protocol, manifest and safe-prefix inputs before outcomes
stop_rule: Exactly three cases, no additional thresholds, candidates or post-result tuning.
numeric_boundary: Raw IEEE64 strict >0 acceleration and inclusive >=0 velocity; no epsilon threshold or smoothing. All three DMA observations must be finite for either nonbaseline mode; first fully defined at index7. Explicit difference-of-differences evaluation order.
hypothesis_basis: Separate bounded hypothesis after failed immediate-side and waiting families: directionally favorable acceleration may detect weakening adverse momentum without entry delay. No claim that the original DiNapoli system uses this added filter.
